media:group.media:title: Prada Fine Jewelry Couleur Vivante | The Prada Cut in Citrine
media:group.media:description:
An expansion of the Prada Fine Jewelry Couleur Vivante collection by Miuccia Prada and Raf Simons. For 2026, new facets emerge, with proportions re-addressed.
Citrine takes form in a Prada Cut mini necklace and stud earrings. The emblematic triangle is traced through the proprietary Prada Cut, a unique gemstone cut calibrated to the specific proportions of this Prada archetype. A single stone becomes the focal point of the mini necklace, its delicate chain and setting in fine white gold appearing to melt away, giving the impression of a pure, floating gemstone.

entry.title: Prada Index | A New Cultural Guide

media:group.media:title: Prada Index | A New Cultural Guide
media:group.media:description:
Prada Index is a new cultural guide offering an in-depth look at the activities of Prada, Fondazione Prada, and Luna Rossa. Its inaugural issue gathers nearly 400 pages of interviews, artworks, photographs, essays and behind-the-scenes documentation, illuminating the major events and exhibitions of 2026 across the Prada universe.
For decades, Prada has approached culture through experimentation, multiplicity, and dialogue - treating making as a means of interrogating ideas rather than fixing their meaning. Prada Index captures this way of working as it continues to unfold, offering both a record and an invitation - points of entry into art, architecture, fashion, filmmaking, design, and, collectively, the culture of Prada itself.

entry.title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Human Catapult

media:group.media:title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Human Catapult
media:group.media:description:
“Human Catapult”: an unprecedented new feat in human flight. Prada Linea Rossa and Red Bull support B.A.S.E. jumpers Dani Roman and Fred Fugen as they launch from a 60-meter-long catapult inside the 360-meter-high Trbovlje chimney in Slovenia. Developed by Slovenian stunt acrobats and engineers DD Squad, the catapult accelerates the athletes from 0 to 180 km/h in just 2.15 seconds. After a brief zero-gravity moment at the flight apex, they transition into freefall before deploying their parachutes and landing. The project earned two Guinness World Records™ titles. Roman reached 100.36 meters above the release point in a single-person launch. During a simultaneous launch, the duo set the greatest combined height by human catapult at 151.72 meters (75.97 meters and 75.75 meters, respectively). Prada Linea Rossa equipped the athletes with functional clothing and accessories, combining comfort and function with a distinctive aesthetic.

media:group.media:title: Prada Holiday 2026 Campaign | "Drawing Prada: Animated by Hand"
media:group.media:description:
Introducing “Drawing Prada”, the Prada Holiday 2026 campaign. A Prada fantasy, created by hand. The Prada Holiday 2026 campaign draws inspiration from the human core of storytelling at the heart of the holiday season. It invents encompassing fantasies, magical impossibilities created by the anachronistic and romantic technique of hand-drawn illustration, the true protagonist for a series of films. Starring Prada Ambassadors Sadie Sink, Maya Hawke, Chen Haoyu, Kelvin Harrison Jr., together with Luther Ford – at its heart the Prada Holiday 2026 campaign is a celebration of craft and process. These subjects are embedded in wonderlands of hand-drawn illustration created by artists led by John Pomeroy, a legendary cinematic animator whose eye has helped define some of the leading productions of the past fifty years.

entry.title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Skateboard Speed World Record with Diego Poncelet

media:group.media:title: Prada Linea Rossa x Red Bull | Skateboard Speed World Record with Diego Poncelet
media:group.media:description:
151.83 km/h. The fastest speed ever recorded on a skateboard. Prada Linea Rossa joins Red Bull athlete and two-time downhill world champion Diego Poncelet in the Skateboard Speed World Record project, supporting his pursuit of a historic milestone. On a closed section of Route des Éboulements in Québec, Canada, Poncelet surpasses the previous world record following years of research, training, and technical development. Working closely with the athlete, Prada Linea Rossa developed bespoke footwear and gloves, combining high-performance materials with protection, comfort, and grip. Every detail contributed to a system engineered for control at extreme speeds. A new chapter in the ongoing partnership between Prada Linea Rossa and Red Bull, challenging conventions and redefining the boundaries of human performance.
